event: He wakes Sunday morning and dresses in slacks and the adventurer shirt he wears to ren faires.

memory.fact: Alan has an adventurer shirt he wears to ren faires.

event: He walks to the Rock Canyon trailhead and starts up between the high rock walls.
The trail climbs steady and rocky, and the canyon is cool and quiet this early.
Higher up, the walls give way to pine forest, the way they did in the dream.
A little after ten he hears a bright voice ahead, talking to someone he can't see.
A small clearing opens beside the trail, sun slanting through the tall pines, just as he dreamed it.
She is there: long loose auburn-chestnut hair, freckles, vivid green eyes, long pointed ears.

changes.note: Alan meets the woman from his dream, filed as a character of the game

event: She is mid-lunge, talking brightly to a phone on a small tripod on a stump, hands going.

memory.fact: On Sunday mornings Aelwyn works out in the pine clearing high up Rock Canyon.

event: "And that's the whole secret, travelers. You move because the day has moving in it!"

memory.fact: Aelwyn records her workouts on her phone, talking to viewers she calls travelers.
Aelwyn records her workouts on her phone, talking to viewers she calls travelers.

event: Between one word and the next she glances past the phone, straight at him, and her face lights.
Her eyes go to his shirt, and her grin gets wider.
To the phone: "Okay, WAIT. A fellow adventurer just walked into frame. This is so on-brand!"
She lifts the phone off the tripod and turns it around on him, still recording.

memory.fact: Aelwyn called Alan a fellow adventurer and turned her phone on him, still recording.
